question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**ascent**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The passage is about mountain climbing, specifically describing the journey to the summit of Nanga Parbat.
 
• The word "**ascent**" means the act of climbing or moving upward, which perfectly matches the context. (चढ़ाई)
 
 
• **Example:** The first **ascent** to Mount Everest was made in 1953 by Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay.
 
 
 
• Thus, "**ascent**" is the most suitable option compared to the other words.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2 - ascent**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Rise** (उठना): Refers to going up but does not specifically describe climbing a mountain summit.

 
 
• **Example:** The sun will rise in the east tomorrow.
 
 
 
• **Lift** (उठाना): Means to pick up or raise something physically, not appropriate in the mountaineering context.
 
 
• **Example:** He used all his strength to lift the heavy box.
 
 
 
• **Launch** (प्रक्षेपण करना): Used for starting something forcefully like a rocket or a program, not for climbing.
 
 
• **Example:** The company will launch its new product next month.
